messages:
irina: quick flag — noticed support-role users can see org-level quota & cost dashboards in the admin console. I think this started after yesterday's rbac-refactor deployment.

sam: oof. can you repro and share a screenshot?

irina: repro'd with a support test account. screenshot attached (redacted). they can open /admin/usage and hit export CSV.

marta: that export contains per-tenant token counts and token-level cost columns, right?

irina: yep, full usage rows + cost breakdowns per project id.

jon: did the rbac changes intentionally widen read scopes? i thought support was supposed to see tickets, not org billing.

sam: checking the diff now. my local branch shows we renamed some scopes: `billing.view` -> `billing.*` in the role-mapping script :(

alex: that would explain it — wildcard expansion happened when we switched to the new role resolver. The resolver treats `billing.*` as inclusive of exports.

billing-bot: alert: /export-csv endpoint used by user support_bot_test at 2026-03-19T11:22:10Z — 1 file downloaded.

marta: we need to treat this as sensitive. Cost data is PII-ish for certain customers and is a compliance breach risk.

sam: agreed. mitigation steps: 1) roll back role-mapping patch immediately, 2) revoke existing support tokens that used export, 3) audit S3 export logs and KMS decrypt calls.

irina: i'm worried about KMS: if support exported encrypted files, we need to check which KMS key was used and whether the decrypt logs show usage by support service account.

alex: decrypts are logged in CloudKMS audit logs. i can query: `resource.type="kms_key" protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail="support@redwood"` and timewindow since deploy. will run now.

jon: also add a policy to the console to hide /admin/usage for non-admins until this is fixed. quick frontend guard can reduce blast radius.

sam: frontend guard pushed as temporary: `if (!user.is_admin) return 403` — i'll open a hotfix PR.

marta: legal/compliance notified? i can ping them after we confirm export recipients.

irina: yes please. i started a downstream incident ticket INC-2026-045 in incidents. linking here: https://internal/incidents/INC-2026-045

billing-bot: note: 1 user-agent IP for export: 52.14.99.11 (aws eu-west-1) captured.

alex: kms query done — there are 3 decrypt events for the export key between 11:21:50Z and 11:22:15Z by service account `support-service@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`.

jon: good info. make a short timeline in the ticket: deploy time, when export happened, which accounts. we should also capture which tenants appear in the CSV.

irina: i've pulled the CSV and redacted customer names; seems mostly internal dev orgs but there are two paying customers included.

marta: escalate to compliance with that timeline and redacted sample. i'll draft email.

sam: PR #4523 created to revert role-mapping change and add unit test for wildcard expansion. hotfix branch `hotfix/rbac-export-lock` created.

alex: i'll revoke support-service key and rotate the KMS key used for exports, but rotation is heavy — recommend immediate IAM revoke on support service account so decrypts stop.

jon: ops: please revoke tokens, rotate creds, and block export endpoint at the edge.

sam: rolling back now. setting deploy block until PR passes.

irina: thanks everyone. follow-ups: 1) audit full S3 access/exports, 2) add e2e test to ensure only admin roles can access billing/export, 3) update RBAC docs to avoid `*` expansions, 4) postmortem if customers affected.

marta: i'll coordinate compliance and legal steps.

jon: once hotfix is live, let's run a short security review of other wildcard mappings. might be a general class of risk.

irina: noted. will add to backlog and tag as P0 for sec-eng.

sam: hotfix deployed at 11:40Z, export endpoint returning 403 for support test account. monitoring for other failed/successful exports.

billing-bot: alert: subsequent export attempts blocked at 11:40:22Z (403).

irina: closing loop — created task SEC-233 to audit and SEC-234 to add tests. leave incident open until compliance signs off.

marta: thanks, will update compliance ticket in 30m. :thumbsup:

jon: nice response team. short retrospective after this.

irina: thanks all.
